data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus/(deficit) run-off deviation of (GBP 8.6) million was experienced in 2016 (2015 (GBP 3.4) million surplus).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2015 with gross claims outstanding of approximately GBP 239.2m (opening reserves for 2016). The report notes a run-off deviation described as a deficit of GBP 8.6m in 2016 (compared with a GBP 3.4m surplus in 2015), indicating adverse prior year development (strengthening). No unambiguous gross prior-year movement total for pre-2016 underwriting years was located in the available tables; the statement of a run-off deficit is the principal textual evidence of adverse development.
raw_causal_phrases: A surplus/(deficit) run-off deviation of (GBP 8.6) million was experienced in 2016 (2015 (GBP 3.4) million surplus).
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction from scanned images. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Claims Outstanding / Technical provisions table (closing 2015 gross claims outstanding = GBP 239,233k). The report text references a 'surplus/(deficit) run-off deviation of (GBP 8.6) million' in 2016 but no clear single-line gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' value was unambiguously identified in the scanned pages; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. The segmental gross premium mix table was not reliably parsed from the images and so is omitted. No clear, quantifiable named events or a usable gross claims development triangle were found in the provided images. Figures are in thousands on the source; amounts converted to millions for output. Image quality limits confidence in some line-item identifications.
